['Celanese GmbH '].company_description: Celanese GmbH is a global technology and specialty materials company that operates in the production of engineered materials, acetyl chain, cellulose acetate, and food ingredients. The company has over 7,700 employees across the globe and operates in 40 countries, manufacturing products in 11 facilities.

['Bernard Krone Holding GmbH & Co. KG '].company_description: Bernard Krone Holding SE & Co. KG is an agricultural technology and commercial vehicle manufacturer based in Spelle in the Emsland district, Lower Saxony. The company acts as the parent company and corporate headquarters of the Krone Group. The Krone Group is wholly owned by the Krone family.
